description: This file defines the RecipeRepository class, which provides methods to fetch and search for Recipe objects from local JSON mock data.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: A simple repository class for retrieving and searching recipes from local mock data.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all recipes by loading a JSON string from asset and parsing it into a list of Recipe objects.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search over all recipes based on title, tags, or description and returns matching recipes.
